note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording and translator-rendered verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that chapter's block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or OWB pieces joined with '…'. Acts 9:6's question is quoted from Acts 22:10.

`self_rendered` rows are quotations recast to fit Meyer's sentence (person or case changed), readings Meyer argues from that OWB does not carry (Prov 23:7, the Lord's Prayer doxology, Revised Version margin readings, Weymouth's 1 Cor 13, the critical-text gaps in Matt 20:7 and Mark 10:21), and allusions in Meyer's own voice left as prose. Rows without chapter_order are carried over from the first edition's notes (allusions and bare citations).
